title: When there is no formula
objectives: Approximate an integral with the trapezium rule in code.
Predict how the error falls as $n$ grows

widget.solution:
def trapezium(f, a, b, n):
    h = (b - a) / n
    total = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        left = a + i * h
        right = left + h
        total += h * (f(left) + f(right)) / 2
    return total
